title: "Eric Eliot Schnitger's Portfolio"
---
I once gave a conference talk called “Why Isn’t Everyone Paid Enough?” I’m still working on the answer, now with Python.

I wrote a dissertation on complicity in capitalism, taught for a while, and attained the holy grail of American life, health insurance, by working retail. I’m a researcher and analyst interested in economic justice, climate, and what an economy looks like when it stops treating growth as the point. I trained as an ethicist, which taught me to ask better questions. I learned SQL, R, and Tableau so I could test the answers against data, which turned out to be its own rabbit hole.

This site is where the projects and writing end up. My resume lives on the [About page](about.qmd). It’s a fun read.
